description: WipeTower consumer-boundary mutations for zero scaling, ramming, ironing area, and minimum prime volume. The separate interface purge baseline defect receives no coverage credit.

mutants.old: wipe_volumes[i][j] = std::max<float>(wipe_volumes[i][j], float(block[size_t(i) * number_of_extruders + j]) * scale);
mutants.new: wipe_volumes[i][j] = std::max<float>(wipe_volumes[i][j], float(block[size_t(i) * number_of_extruders + j]) * (scale == 0. ? 1. : scale));
mutants.intended_failed_case: Zero purge scaling and destination floor follow the tower volume rules
mutants.description: Treat a zero per-nozzle scale as the default scale of one while preserving all positive-scale behavior. The zero-scale matrix row must remain zero when destination floors are zero.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Zero multi-tool ramming inputs suppress the ramming move
mutants.description: Mistake the documented zero-volume disable value for a positive minimum of 1 cubic millimeter. Positive configured volumes remain unchanged; zero-volume output must match explicitly disabled ramming.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Minimum prime volume preserves a positive tower transition
mutants.description: Drop the configured Type2 purge volume at its Print consumer. The public Print pair at the registered minimum and a meaningful positive control must retain equal transition identities and show the configured volume effect.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Zero tower ironing area removes the public ironing travel
mutants.description: Treat a zero Type1 ironing area as the default 4 square millimeters while preserving the positive-area row. The zero-area output must match the same-area control with flat ironing disabled.
